hash_method: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 file text after CRLF -> LF normalization, lowercase hex

registry_map_equals_BA-02a.detail: class, AFFECTED_GROUPS and IN_PREDICATE of every key of the JSON REGISTRY_MAP equal BA-02a V3 section 2 (V2.2 PA-1.2)

group_table_equals_BA-02a.detail: the JSON GROUP_TABLE equals BA-02a V3 section 3 (V2.2 PA-1.3)

v4_schema_fields_present.detail: every scenario has exactly the V4 schema fields

build_under_test_values.detail: NONE only for synthetic scenarios (REACH SYN)

groups_served_equals_derivation.detail: GROUPS_SERVED == ordered union of AFFECTED_GROUPS(CONTROLS_EXERCISED) then EVIDENCE_GROUPS_DECLARED; nothing else

contract_assigned_groups_separate.detail: each entry is {group, clause}, a CONTROL group, never in GROUPS_SERVED (evidence only, never PASS-bearing; AR3-06)

group_is_served_or_contract_assigned.detail: the primary GROUP is served or contract-assigned; HDM (not a PA-1.3 group) is the declared exception

ar3_01_mode_fields.detail: RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED set, CHARACTERIZATION_BUILD, PROVISIONAL_NON_GOVERNING, CHARACTERIZATION_TUPLE; no EVM, HOST_DEFAULT_MAP, E-04 pin or K-3

ar3_01_extension_is_a_labelled_proposal.detail: every AR3-01-mode scenario outside E4-LEARN-R1-*, LK-*, HDM-CHAR-*, WU-DRY-* is governing, DRAFT, BLOCKED_BY AQ-V4-01 and labels its mode as a PROPOSAL; for EV-L-* the contract-grounded part (V2.1 27.2: E-12 phases A and C) and the proposal (E-03, E-04, S-1..S-3) are stated apart; md 1.1 states the scope

wu_dry_exactly_one_per_governing_window_.detail: the one rule of BA-09 V4 section 4: every GOVERNING scenario of MODE CHARACTERIZATION_RUN or VALIDATION with REACH in P0..CP has exactly one WU-DRY-<id>; no other scenario has one; a dry run carries only the FIXTURE_INSTANCE slots of its source (fixture and variant library), WU_DRY_RUNS = N_B, the source injections, the AR3-01 set and the source blockers AQ-V4-01 and K-8

wu_dry_for_the_named_scenarios.detail: the 11 evidence scenarios of BA04V3-02 / D-05, the two new governing scenarios and the four Q-I14-* vehicles (AR3-02 read literally)

dry_run_residual_branches_listed.detail: the sources whose declared refusal or abort comes from a control of the RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED set are listed in section 5.2 and in their dry run (BA-09 V4 residual)

flags_targets_designed_stimuli.detail: DESIGNED_STIMULUS != NONE => flag NO; flag YES => a registry control or INSTRUMENT:I-nn target; flag NO => target NONE

yes_target_result_names_the_failure.detail: AR2-09: the target control's expected result names its FAIL, UNKNOWN, difference or rejection

conditional_e12c_cells_target_e12c.detail: AR3-05: a scan cell whose detection is conditional on E-12 phase C (not a secondary channel) targets E12C

sealed_at_recomputes.detail: SHA-256 over the canonical serialization (sorted keys, UTF-8, separators "," and ":", no ASCII escaping) of the fields of SEALED_AT_RULE

expected_outcome_kinds.detail: exact O1..O7, NONE, a declared conditional, PROVISIONAL_NON_GOVERNING or the outcome of the preceding run

k3_exactly_where_s1_s3_are_adjudicated.detail: governing host scenario outside the AR3-01 mode with REACH PV or CP

blocked_by_values.detail: BLOCKED_BY uses only the vocabulary (K-3, K-8, K-6 (AQ-V4-07, Q-HDM-1), AQ-V4-01, AQ-V4-03, E6-C4); E6-C4 only on NC-S5-O6; K-6 only on CL-CLEAN-FXANNBLANK-FP; AQ-V4-03 exactly on KS-*; AQ-V4-01 exactly on EV-L-*, Q-I14-* and their dry runs

blockers_declared_in_sections_1_and_7_an.detail: every BLOCKED_BY value is in the section 1 vocabulary; every value other than E6-C4 is a section 7.1 seal blocker; K-6 and the AQ blockers are in the header PREREQUISITES

param_03_sample.detail: the governing CL-CLEAN-<fixture> scenarios plus EA2-DEFERRED-EVENTS carry the CLEAN rule, and no other (AR3-24)

repetition_label_equals_ba10_derivation.detail: AR3-24 and BA-10 V4 section 2.2: the REPETITION label of every scenario is the first matching row of the BA-10 V4 rule table with N_strict = N_A (class A only), N_B (class B only) or max(N_A, N_B) (both; no ordering assumed) and CHAR_RUNS resolved; every mixed-class governing label reads max(N_A, N_B)

expected_result_keys_exercised_or_declar.detail: every registry key of EXPECTED_CONTROL_RESULTS is in CONTROLS_EXERCISED, or its value is NOT_DECLARED, or it is a control of the scenario's own RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED set with the value RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED

fpspec_vector_ids_and_outcomes.detail: Q-FPSPEC-VECTORS names exactVectors, rejectedInputs and semanticVectors, expects every DIGEST, UNKNOWN and REJECTED (RJ-01..RJ-nn) and the INVALID instance rule of BA-05 V4 3.3.1, binds the BA-08 SEAL_HASH; Q-SIGNED-ZERO cites EV-01, EV-02, SV-05, EV-06, EV-07, which hold those outcomes

ba02b_no_coverage_gap_except_declared_co.detail: every control is COVERED_DRAFT, or COVERED_DRAFT_CONDITIONAL (only conditional negative controls: NEGATIVE_CONTROL_NOT_EVALUATED at acceptance, AR3-03)

ba02b_group_coverage_recomputed.detail: contract-assigned scenarios are counted apart and never as serving or countable

ba02b_section3_rows_verbatim.detail: the five cells of every row in effect equal the contract cells (V2.1 31: 22 rows incl. the four NOT_A_CONTROL rows; V2.2 PA-1.4: 7 rows)

ba02b_section3_discharges.detail: each clause is a verbatim fragment of its row; each listed scenario exists and is a class member or a declared exception

ba02b_section3_every_row_discharged.detail: every row has clauses and every clause has at least one non-exploratory scenario (MET_IN_DRAFT)
